Not found on this build: the see-through wall fade (walls fade as the game has them). Not tried on a headset.

note: Offline only: D2R VR Unleashed runs through D2RLoader with -mod, which keeps D2R off Battle.net game servers.

runtime.license: wineopenxr bridge LGPL-2.1-or-later, OXRSys MPL-2.0; scripts/build-vr-runtime.sh rebuilds it from pinned commits

patch.why: D3DMetal releases ReShade's per-resource destroy tracker after the resource's C++ destructor ran, so ID3D12Resource::GetDesc (vtable slot 10) is null there. Skip the desc / GPU address cleanup and only free the tracker.

mod_patch.license: MPL-2.0; source patch and license in patches/d2r-pcvr; rebuild with scripts/build-vr-mod.py

ngx_unwrap.note: nvngx.dll in front of Apple NGX shim: passes it the real D3D12 objects instead of ReShade wrappers
